name: gaia
description: One window over every forge on a machine: what waits on User, every running agent, and every forge's state and controls

scripts.typecheck: bun run --parallel typecheck:root typecheck:page typecheck:page-specs typecheck:architecture typecheck:design-system typecheck:flint typecheck:brand
scripts.lint: eslint . --cache --cache-strategy content --cache-location node_modules/.cache/lint/ && bun run lint:design-system && bun run lint:flint && bun run lint:brand
scripts.lint:fix: eslint . --cache --cache-strategy content --cache-location node_modules/.cache/lint/ --fix && bun run lint:design-system --fix && bun run lint:flint --fix && bun run lint:brand --fix
scripts.test:dom: bun page/testing/RunDomSpecs.ts && bun page/lib/design-system/testing/RunDomSpecs.ts && bun page/lib/flint/testing/RunDomSpecs.ts && bun page/lib/brand/testing/RunDomSpecs.ts
scripts.verify: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun test && bun run test:architecture && bun run test:dom && bun run check
